invariants.rationale: The commitInternal method uses instantTime, which should not be null to identify the commit; a null value might violate downstream invariants.
partitionPath serves as the key in the singletonMap and thus needs to be non-null for correct map behavior.
records is provided as a value in the Map and used for downstream processing, so it must not be null.
indexParser is an argument for assisting with index parsing operations and is likely required by downstream logic.
A partition path being non-empty is typically required for proper mapping and processing in dataset partitioned storage systems.
